brief:
Resistance committees in Palestine marked the second anniversary of Yahya Sinwar's death with a statement affirming that the former Hamas political bureau chief left behind a legacy of resistance and steadfastness, Shehab Wire reported. The committees said his memory would remain present in Palestinian consciousness.

Sinwar, also known as Abu Ibrahim, was killed two years ago. The resistance committees did not provide further details about planned commemorations or activities.
